Axum applies `layer()` and `route_layer()` eagerly to routes already present; `merge()` copies the sub-router’s already-layered routes, so a parent `route_layer()` does not affect routes merged afterward. Tower’s `ServiceBuilder` stores layers in a `Stack` whose `layer()` application makes the newest builder layer outermost.

Relevant files:

- [sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5:axum/src/routing/mod.rs?L222-L272](/r/github.com/sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5/-/blob/axum/src/routing/mod.rs?L222-L272) - `Router::merge` consumes and merges the other router’s `PathRouter`; it does not reapply the receiver’s middleware.
- [sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5:axum/src/routing/mod.rs?L274-L307](/r/github.com/sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5/-/blob/axum/src/routing/mod.rs?L274-L307) - `Router::layer` applies to path routes, fallback routes, and catch-all fallback; `Router::route_layer` delegates only to `PathRouter::route_layer`.
- [sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5:axum/src/routing/path_router.rs?L245-L290](/r/github.com/sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5/-/blob/axum/src/routing/path_router.rs?L245-L290) - `PathRouter::layer`/`route_layer` iterate existing endpoints and wrap each with `endpoint.layer(...)`; routes added later are untouched.
- [sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5:axum/src/docs/routing/route_layer.md?L1-L12](/r/github.com/sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5/-/blob/axum/src/docs/routing/route_layer.md?L1-L12) - Documents that `route_layer()` runs only for matched routes and only applies to existing routes.
- [sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5:axum/src/docs/routing/layer.md?L1-L8](/r/github.com/sg-evals/axum--axum-v0.7.5/-/blob/axum/src/docs/routing/layer.md?L1-L8) - Documents the same existing-route behavior for `Router::layer()`, while also applying to fallback services.
- [sg-evals/tower--tower-0.4.13:tower/src/builder/mod.rs?L116-L136](/r/github.com/sg-evals/tower--tower-0.4.13/-/blob/tower/src/builder/mod.rs?L116-L136) - `ServiceBuilder::layer` constructs `Stack<T, L>`, adding the new layer ahead of prior layers.
- [sg-evals/tower--tower-0.4.13:tower-layer/src/stack.rs?L4-L30](/r/github.com/sg-evals/tower--tower-0.4.13/-/blob/tower-layer/src/stack.rs?L4-L30) - `Stack::layer` first applies `Inner`, then `Outer`; therefore the newly added builder layer is the outer layer and executes first.
